name: Wings_3
short_caption: The robot opens its arms wide to the sides, presenting a welcoming and open posture.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral rest pose and quickly lifts both arms outward to the sides, bending at the elbows with palms facing forward. It holds this wide, open wing-like posture briefly, tilting its head slightly upward. Finally, it smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot's arms extend wide to both sides, requiring a clear lateral clearance zone of about 0.5 meters on each side to avoid obstacles.
